title: Getting Ready Every Morning
text: Every morning, I wash my face and comb my hair in front of the mirror. Then I brush my teeth with my toothbrush and toothpaste. My mom uses shampoo and soap when she takes a shower. After that, I put on my slippers and use a towel to wipe my hands. I always remember to wash my hands before breakfast!
